description: This file defines a class `HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule_Edit` which extends `HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule`. The class sets up an 'Edit' module for HTML purification, adding elements 'del' and 'ins' with specific attributes and handling child element definitions for inline and block contexts within the purifier.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule_Edit
classes.description: Defines the 'Edit' module for HTMLPurifier with elements 'del' and 'ins' for editing annotations, managing inline and block context constraints.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the module by adding 'del' and 'ins' elements with specific content model and attributes.

methods.name: getChildDef
methods.description: Returns a chameleon child definition to handle inline/block context switching based on the content model.
